Meet your host

The person to call when a file doesn't fit the box.

Adam works with brokers across Ontario North to find a way to yes on the files the banks pass on. Once a month he opens up his desk to a small group, takes the scenarios you send in, and walks through exactly how Highclere would structure them.

You leave with a plan for your file, and a direct line to the person who can get it done.

How it works

Four steps. Thirty minutes.
One file closer to funded.

Seats are capped at 15 so everyone gets a real answer. Every request is checked by hand, so the room is brokers only.

01

Request a seat

Tell us your brokerage and licence number. Send in the file you want help with, minus client names.

02

Get your private link

Once your licence checks out, you get a personal join link, a calendar invite and reminders.

03

Join live

Adam walks through 2 or 3 real files, step by step, then opens it up for your questions.

04

Book your 1:1

Got one on your desk right now? Book 15 minutes with Adam to work through it together.

What we solve

The files that keep you up at night.

These are the scenarios brokers bring most. Hover a card to see how Highclere would approach it.

Self-employed

In business less than 2 years

The bank wants two years of tax returns. Your client has 18 months.
How we'd do itBusiness for Self, Under 2 Years. We look at business bank statements to show real income.
Newcomer

New to Canada

Arrived in the last 5 years with a thin Canadian credit history.
How we'd do itNew to Canada program, with options to support international credit and banking history.
Investor

Rentals, 2 to 4 units

Strong portfolio, but the income doesn't stack up the way the bank wants.
How we'd do itRental Program 2 to 4 Units, using the subject property's rental income to qualify.
Alt-A

The bank said "not yet"

Good client, solid equity, a credit file with a story.
How we'd do itRenaissance, our Alt-A program for clients who don't fit conventional guidelines.

Questions

Good to know.

Who can attend?+

Licensed mortgage brokers and agents. We check every licence number before sending a join link, which keeps the room focused on brokers.

Does it cost anything?+

No. Highclere Helps is free for licensed brokers.

What should I send in?+

Any scenario you're stuck on. Share the numbers that matter (income type, down payment, credit, property) and leave out client names and personal details.

Is it recorded?+

No. Keeping it live and off the record means we can talk through real files openly. Every attendee gets a short recap and the checklist after.

What if I can't make it?+

Pick the next session, or book a 15-minute 1:1 with Adam any time from his booking page.
